entries.title: Galatians 6:1
segments: Brothers, if a man is overtaken in a fault, you the spiritual ones restore such a one in the spirit of meekness, considering yourself, lest you also be tempted.

entries.title: Galatians 6:2
segments: Bear one another's burdens, and so you will fulfill the law of Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 6:3
segments: For if anyone thinks himself to be something, being nothing, he deceives himself.

entries.title: Galatians 6:4
segments: But let each one prove his own work, and then he alone will have a boast in himself, and not in another.

entries.title: Galatians 6:5
segments: For each one will bear [his] own load.

entries.title: Galatians 6:6
segments: But let him who is taught in the Word share with the [one] teaching in all good things.

entries.title: Galatians 6:7
segments: Do not be deceived, God is not mocked. For whatever a man sows, that he also will reap.

entries.title: Galatians 6:8
segments: For he sowing to his flesh will reap corruption from the flesh. But he sowing to the Spirit will reap life everlasting from the Spirit.

entries.title: Galatians 6:9
segments: But we should not lose heart in well-doing, for in due season we shall reap, if [we] do not faint.

entries.title: Galatians 6:10
segments: So then as we have time, let us work good toward all, especially toward those of the household of faith.

entries.title: Galatians 6:11
segments: See in what large letters I write to you with my hand.

entries.title: Galatians 6:12
segments: As many as desire to look well in [the] flesh, these compel you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 6:13
segments: For they themselves, having been circumcised, do not even keep the Law, but they desire you to be circumcised so that they may boast in your flesh.

entries.title: Galatians 6:14
segments: But may it never be for me to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified to me, and I to the world.

entries.title: Galatians 6:15
segments: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision [has] any strength, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

entries.title: Galatians 6:16
segments: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace and mercy [be] upon them and upon the Israel of God.

entries.title: Galatians 6:17
segments: For the rest, let no one give troubles to me, for I bear in my body the brands of the Lord Jesus.

entries.title: Galatians 6:18
segments: Brothers, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with your spirit. Amen.
